items.title: Tielemans cameo against PSG hints at Man Utd future
items.description: Manchester United's £35m signing Youri Tielemans makes an impressive debut in the 1-1 friendly draw against Paris St-Germain in Gothenburg.

items.title: Nightmare start for Jaissle as Valencia take early lead vs Newcastle LIVE!
'Took him off both his feet!' | Stevie McKenna with HUGE first-round KO
items.description: Stevie McKenna stopped Owen O'Neill with a devastating right hand in the opening round of their contest at Zuffa Boxing 10.

items.title: Trent Rockets seal knockout stage place with win over MI London
items.description: Trent Rockets pair Mitch Santner and Tim David helped steer their side into the knockout stage with a 78-run partnership in a six-wicket win over MI London.

items.title: Mbeumo scores in encouraging Man Utd draw with PSG
items.description: Bryan Mbeumo earned Man Utd a 1-1 draw with Paris St-Germain in Gothenburg, a pre-season friendly which left boss Michael Carrick encouraged by the "good signs" from his side.

items.title: Huang holds narrow lead over Hull at PIF London Championship
items.description: Anna Huang maintained her narrow lead over Charley Hull in the third round of the PIF London Championship.

items.title: Burnley edge win on penalties, West Ham through in Carabao Cup first round
items.description: Kyle Walker struck the winning penalty as Burnley edged out Notts County 4-3 in a shoot-out to reach the Carabao Cup second round after a 1-1 draw at Turf Moor.

items.title: Moore helps GB and Ireland to Shergar Cup crown
items.description: Ryan Moore bagged a Shergar Cup double on his return to the competition following a 20-year absence to help his Great Britain and Ireland team win the team event while he was also crowned leading rider over the six races.

items.title: McKenna vs Oliha LIVE! Hickey blasts Axe out in seven rounds
Phillips hits winner against St Johnstone as St Mirren go top
items.description: Killian Phillips was on target again to keep St Mirren on top of the Premiership for a second Saturday night.

items.title: Bevan dazzles as Dundee crush sorry Aberdeen
items.description: Joe Bevan tormented Aberdeen as Dundee got their first Premiership points on the board with a deserved 2-0 victory at Dens Park.

items.title: Garcia hopes long-term friend Alonso's Chelsea finish second to Liverpool
items.description: As two Liverpool legends meet in pre-season, Luis Garcia says he hopes Xabi Alonso's Chelsea finish behind their former club in the Premier League.
